title: Find the first broken joint.

hook.picture: Close: the whale swims backwards along a very long line, searching. A pod at the far end has answered ✕.
hook.words: The agent ran for an hour.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: The agent ran for an hour. Where did it break?
problem_in_viewer_words.who: engineer debugging an overnight agent run

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: The run is many steps laid end to end. Three times, faster each time, a run fails and the whale starts reading from the first step.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: We read every step by hand.

stakes.body: Every failed agent run costs an hour of reading logs, and the real cause is often far from where it showed up.

solution_hint: Check each step where it meets the next.

metaphor.body: An agent's run is a line of steps. A small gate at each joint checks that what one step hands over fits what the next needs, so the first break lights up.

steps.picture: Each joint between two steps gets a small gate. What one step hands over must fit what the next needs.
The run replays, and the joints glow one by one.
steps.words: Each step promises what the next needs.

steps.picture: Push-in: the fourth joint's bar drops. Step three handed over something step four can't use.
steps.sound: The clicks stop on a stop knock

steps.picture: The whale hops straight to that joint and fixes it.
steps.words: The first broken joint lights up.

steps.picture: The run replays and every joint glows.
Ticks ripple along all the joints.
steps.words: A check at every seam between steps.

real_case.claim: Lean4Agent (Wang et al., 2026, forked by Manu): workflows that passed Lean verification beat failing ones by an average of 11.94%, across 5 leading LLMs on SWE-Bench Verified and ELAIP-Bench subsets.

honest_limit.picture: One step is wrong inside but hands over the right shape. Its joint glows, and a pod at the end answers ✕.
honest_limit.words: A wrong step can still fit its joint.

not_this.body: Steps that fit are not steps that work.

ending_pattern.body: Instead of scrolling the whole run, the whale hops straight to the one glowing joint and fixes it. The pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: Same long line and close framing as bar 1: the endless search becomes one hop.

end_belief.body: Check where steps meet. Find breaks fast.

score_self.reason: Concrete engineering pain and a fast callback. The evidence is third-party (credited as Paper), and 'fit' at joints may read as type-matching, which is close to cluster 04.
